text.card: A red giant 3,176 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.85 solar masses and 7.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,783 K at its surface.
